## Frequently asked questions – Bank of America tips for the holiday season


### Question: How can consumers protect themselves from holiday shopping scams this season?


**Answer:** A little extra caution can go a long way. Holiday scams often look like messages you've seen before, including emails that appear to be from retailers, fake shipping or delivery notifications and requests for personal information. These messages often create a false sense of urgency, pressuring you to act immediately. If you receive an unexpected message or notification and something doesn't seem right, don't click on any links. Instead, go directly to the retailer's website or shipping carrier's app to verify it. Pause before you click on anything – that extra moment of caution can help protect both your personal information and your holiday budget. You can always check[Bank of America Security Center’s Scam Prevention resources](https://web.bankofamerica.com/en/security/scam-prevention) for additional tips and tools to stay safe.


### Question: How can consumers shop smarter this holiday season?


**Answer:** Start with a realistic budget and a spending limit for each person on your list. Compare prices, take advantage of seasonal sales, and consider using credit card rewards, points, or cash back on purchases you already planned to make. Visit[Better Money Habits](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en/saving-budgeting/holiday-shopping-tips) for additional tips for staying on budget and getting the most value from your holiday spending.


### Question: What's the best way to balance holiday spending with financial goals?


**Answer:** Before shopping, identify your top financial priorities for the season and set spending limits that support those goals. Don't let social pressure or gift expectations drive your spending, and remember that meaningful gifts aren't defined by price. By planning ahead, taking advantage of deals, and practicing a "pause before you pay" mindset before making purchases, you can stay on budget while reducing financial stress after the holidays.


### Question: How can shoppers make planned holiday purchases more rewarding?


**Answer:** Start by checking whether retailers offer loyalty points, member discounts, or seasonal promotions on purchases you already plan to make. Then, layer those benefits with rewards from a credit card that aligns with your needs and rewards your spending, such as the[Bank of America® Customized Cash Rewards](https://www.bankofamerica.com/customizedcash) card. Cardholders can earn three percent


3%

6%


cash back bonus offer in their choice category during the first year. Cash rewards can then be redeemed as statement credits or deposited directly into an eligible Bank of America checking or savings account to help offset costs throughout the year.

panel that is representative of the adult U S

The margin of sampling error for the total sample is ±2.2 percentage points at the ninety five percent

The survey data were weighted to match national population benchmarks for gender by age, race/ethnicity, education, Census region, metropolitan status, and household income. Benchmarks for these variables were obtained from the 2025 March Supplement of the Current Population Survey ( C P S
